brief.summary_1line: Allied kings return home and send tribute to Rama, who redistributes the wealth to Sugriva, Vibhishana, Hanuman, Angada, and the monkey leaders.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama seats Hanuman and Angada on his knees in the royal court and adorns them with rare ornaments from his own chest.
Monkey warriors joyfully place jewels and ornaments on their heads and arms after receiving gifts from Rama.
Long processions of kings depart on elephants and horses whose thunderous steps shake the earth as they leave Rama’s court.
